title: 敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐
titleEn: Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs
summary: 敞開式硬岩掘進機依靠撐靴傳遞反力，刀盤後方的岩面可被觀測，但暴露並不等於穩定。本課將岩塊幾何、未支護距離、噴層與錨栓的作用分開建模，再連接收斂、超挖、出碴與資料交接。課程中的梁、重量及時間公式是明示邊界的教學模型，不能據此決定現場進入條件或支護間距。
summaryEn: An open hard-rock TBM reacts through grippers and leaves rock behind the cutterhead available for observation, but exposure is not evidence of stability. This course separates block geometry, unsupported distance, sprayed lining and bolt action, then connects convergence, overbreak, muck handling and handover. Beam, weight and time relations have explicit teaching boundaries; they cannot determine field access conditions or support spacing.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下原創算例針對敞開硬岩掘進後方的暴露跨度、岩塊支護與證據閉合，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。
workedExample.textEn: This original worked example examines exposure, block support and evidence closure behind open hard-rock tbms. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」與「未支護距離與時間窗」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crown blocks and self-weight path" and "Unsupported distance and exposure time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crown blocks and self-weight path: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crown blocks and self-weight path” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩體節理可能切出可移動塊體，其重力由剩餘岩橋、節理摩擦或已核准支護傳遞。僅從岩塊體積可估重量，卻不能證明運動方向與抗力；幾何辨識必須先於支護力的列帳。 假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。 背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discontinuities can isolate movable blocks whose weight is carried by rock bridges, joint resistance or approved support. Volume estimates weight, but neither movement direction nor resistance. Geometric interpretation must therefore precede any accounting of support force. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface. Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact. Weight estimated only from a frontal image can therefore place support discussions on incorrect geometry and understate the consequences of block release. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crown blocks and self-weight path” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crown blocks and self-weight path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑
knowledge.text: 岩體節理可能切出可移動塊體，其重力由剩餘岩橋、節理摩擦或已核准支護傳遞。僅從岩塊體積可估重量，卻不能證明運動方向與抗力；幾何辨識必須先於支護力的列帳。
knowledge.textEn: Discontinuities can isolate movable blocks whose weight is carried by rock bridges, joint resistance or approved support. Volume estimates weight, but neither movement direction nor resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crown blocks and self-weight path" is correct?
options: 表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。
岩體節理可能切出可移動塊體，其重力由剩餘岩橋、節理摩擦或已核准支護傳遞。
機器停止前進就不會增加未支護區的風險。
optionsEn: A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks.
Discontinuities can isolate movable blocks whose weight is carried by rock bridges, joint resistance or approved support.
Stopping machine advance cannot increase risk within the unsupported region behind it.
quiz.explanation: 岩體節理可能切出可移動塊體，其重力由剩餘岩橋、節理摩擦或已核准支護傳遞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Discontinuities can isolate movable blocks whose weight is carried by rock bridges, joint resistance or approved support. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crown blocks and self-weight path: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crown blocks and self-weight path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Crown blocks and self-weight path", which statement holds?
options: 噴凝土總量充足便保證每一處厚度與接觸良好。
兩次讀值的平均速率能完整表示區間內變形歷程。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: An adequate total sprayed-concrete quantity guarantees sufficient thickness and contact everywhere.
The average between two readings fully describes deformation throughout the entire interval.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crown blocks and self-weight path: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crown blocks and self-weight path” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines. Record hidden rear boundaries. Compare alternative geometries for their effects on weight and possible motion; the engineering geologist determines what additional evidence is needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：岩塊圖保留方位、比例尺與不可見區，不以課堂重量安排人員進入；支護與進入條件均由現場授權人員依核准風險程序決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain orientation, scale and hidden regions on the block map. Do not use the classroom weight to authorize access. Authorized site personnel determine support and entry conditions through the approved risk procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines. Record hidden rear boundaries. Compare alternative geometries for their effects on weight and possible motion; the engineering geologist determines what additional evidence is needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 岩塊圖保留方位、比例尺與不可見區，不以課堂重量安排人員進入；支護與進入條件均由現場授權人員依核准風險程序決定。
knowledge.textEn: Retain orientation, scale and hidden regions on the block map. Do not use the classroom weight to authorize access. Authorized site personnel determine support and entry conditions through the approved risk procedure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crown blocks and self-weight path"?
options: 由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
皮帶瞬時額定能力高於切削需求便不可能積碴。
optionsEn: Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A belt rating above cutting demand makes muck accumulation impossible under all conditions.
quiz.explanation: 由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crown blocks and self-weight path: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crown blocks and self-weight path” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact. Weight estimated only from a frontal image can therefore place support discussions on incorrect geometry and understate the consequences of block release. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Weight estimated only from a frontal image can therefore place support discussions on incorrect geometry and understate the consequences of block release.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 噴層跨越小空洞或不平整岩面時可能局部彎曲，純膜力假設會失效。矩形單位寬條帶可展示厚度對截面模數的平方影響，但真實黏結、裂縫與纖維殘餘強度必須另行檢查。 假設寬b=1 m、厚t=0.12 m、彎矩M=2 kN·m，彈性應力6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa；t降至0.10 m時為1.2 MPa。 背面空洞使噴層成為小跨梁，薄區應力增大且可能出現網狀裂紋；若只檢核平均噴量，局部厚度不足與失去接觸的影響會被掩蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「噴層厚度與局部彎曲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

A unit-width rectangular strip demonstrates the squared influence of thickness on section modulus. Actual bond, cracking and residual fiber strength require separate checks. Assume width b=1 m, thickness t=0.12 m and moment M=2 kN·m. Elastic stress 6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa; reducing t to 0.10 m gives 1.2 MPa. A rear void makes the layer span locally, increasing stress at thin zones and potentially producing a crack network. Checking only average applied quantity can conceal insufficient local thickness and the loss of contact behind the lining. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sprayed-layer thickness and local bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對齊皮帶稱重或流量估計、運輸事件與暫存位置觀察，檢查啟停期間的資料缺口。
梁模型算出的低撓度便證明岩體暴露跨度安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Synchronize belt weighing or flow estimates, transport events and buffer observations.
A small calculated beam deflection proves that the exposed rock span is safe.
quiz.explanation: 對齊皮帶稱重或流量估計、運輸事件與暫存位置觀察，檢查啟停期間的資料缺口；用累計入出量與實際積存變化核對平衡，若長期偏差存在，先查量測基準而不是假定岩體密度突然改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize belt weighing or flow estimates, transport events and buffer observations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 運碴能力與積存狀態：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mucking capacity and accumulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「運碴能力與積存狀態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mucking capacity and accumulation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: As a buffer approaches capacity, backup can interfere with cutting and support logistics. Reporting only peak belt capability ignores stoppages and transfer losses, hiding the actual bottleneck within otherwise acceptable shift averages. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reporting only peak belt capability ignores stoppages and transfer losses, hiding the actual bottleneck within otherwise acceptable shift averages.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「皮帶瞬時額定能力高於切削需求便不可能積碴。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A belt rating above cutting demand makes muck accumulation impossible under all conditions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環境量測的換氣尺度」與「支護交接與抽驗代表性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation mixing-time scale" and "Support handover and sampling coverage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環境量測的換氣尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation mixing-time scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環境量測的換氣尺度」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation mixing-time scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想完全混合控制體積的換氣時間可比較風量與空間大小，但隧道實際流場含短路和死角。平均濃度模型不處理局部粉塵峰值、燃燒氣體或緊急情境，因此計算不能取代暴露評估。 假設有效體積V=600 m³、潔淨風量Q=20 m³/s，時間常數τ=V/Q=30 s；無持續污染源時90%衰減需ln(10)τ=69.1 s。 風流短路可能讓出口讀值良好而作業區仍累積污染，平均衰減公式會低估死角清除時間；若據此安排人員接近，模型簡化就被錯當暴露許可。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環境量測的換氣尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An ideal well-mixed volume gives a timescale for comparing airflow and space. Real tunnels contain short circuits and stagnant zones. A mean-concentration model excludes local dust peaks, combustion products and emergency conditions, so it cannot replace an exposure assessment. Assume effective volume V=600 m³ and clean airflow Q=20 m³/s. Time constant τ=V/Q=30 s; with no continuing source, 90% decay requires ln(10)τ=69.1 s. Air short-circuiting can produce a good outlet reading while contaminants persist elsewhere. The average decay model understates clearance in stagnant zones; using it to permit access wrongly turns a simplifying assumption into exposure authorization. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation mixing-time scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When the calculated exchange time elapses, every location is necessarily safe to enter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環境量測的換氣尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 環境量測的換氣尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation mixing-time scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環境量測的換氣尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation mixing-time scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設有效體積V=600 m³、潔淨風量Q=20 m³/s，時間常數τ=V/Q=30 s；無持續污染源時90%衰減需ln(10)τ=69.1 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume effective volume V=600 m³ and clean airflow Q=20 m³/s. Time constant τ=V/Q=30 s; with no continuing source, 90% decay requires ln(10)τ=69.1 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以核准儀器在多個位置量測風速與相關環境指標，保留位置、設備活動及採樣時間；比較空間差異以檢查完全混合假設，不能只在風管出口量一次就宣稱工作區達到要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use approved instruments at multiple locations for velocity and relevant environmental indicators, retaining position, machine activity and sampling time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設有效體積V=600 m³、潔淨風量Q=20 m³/s，時間常數τ=V/Q=30 s；無持續污染源時90%衰減需ln(10)τ=69.1 s。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume effective volume V=600 m³ and clean airflow Q=20 m³/s. Time constant τ=V/Q=30 s; with no continuing source, 90% decay requires ln(10)τ=69.1 s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 環境量測的換氣尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation mixing-time scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環境量測的換氣尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ventilation mixing-time scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以核准儀器在多個位置量測風速與相關環境指標，保留位置、設備活動及採樣時間；比較空間差異以檢查完全混合假設，不能只在風管出口量一次就宣稱工作區達到要求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use approved instruments at multiple locations for velocity and relevant environmental indicators, retaining position, machine activity and sampling time. Compare spatial differences to test mixing assumptions. A single reading at a duct outlet cannot demonstrate acceptable conditions across the work area. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把混合模型與實測暴露記錄分開，測點與允收由職業衛生及通風負責人核准；課堂時間僅用於理解尺度，不作人員進入判準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate the mixing model from measured exposure records. Occupational-hygiene and ventilation leads approve sampling locations and acceptance criteria; the classroom time illustrates scale and is not a criterion for personnel entry.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：風流短路可能讓出口讀值良好而作業區仍累積污染，平均衰減公式會低估死角清除時間；若據此安排人員接近，模型簡化就被錯當暴露許可。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Air short-circuiting can produce a good outlet reading while contaminants persist elsewhere. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
